title: Excalibane's Adventure
description: Venture in to the wilds of a new realm, building as high as you want. Vanilla
body:
### Join Excalibane as the first generation.
  **Exiled from the gods pure realm, you are cast into the mortal worlds forced to survive.**
 
  ![the infamous Plains biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/862657306f92faaf72ae3f27f1d13c7082218779.webp)

 ### Start Excalibanes story 
Within this mystical world there are many regrets from the gods. It is a place of new beginings and friendships , maybe even civilization


<details>
